2609.20057.title: WiCleanData: Guaranteeing the Type Consistency of Wikidata by Taxonomy Refinement and Constraint Enforcement
2609.20057.paper_summary: Because of its collaborative nature, Wikidata suffers from errors, in- consistencies, and excessive complexity, such as redundant classes, ambiguity between instances and classes, wrong taxonomic paths, and type constraint violations. The manual curation of these issues is infeasible at scale. To address these challenges, we introduce WiCleanData, a refined version of Wikidata with a consistent tax- onomy and free from type constraint violations. Specifically, we have designed an automated pipeline that first cleans the taxonomy with language model assistance, then simplifies type constraints by hierarchical aggregation, and finally filters facts accordingly. The resulting knowledge graph, free from any type violation, is made publicly available via a Web interface, enabling easy exploration and downstream applications.
2609.20057.paper_summary_zh: 因為其協作性質，Wikidata 遭受錯誤、不一致性和過度複雜性等問題，例如冗餘類別、實例與類別之間的模糊性、錯誤的分類路徑以及類型約束違規。這些問題的手動整理在大規模上是不可行的。為了解決這些挑戰，我們推出了 WiCleanData，這是一個經過精煉的 Wikidata 版本，擁有一致的分類法並且不受類型約束違規的影響。具體而言，我們設計了一個自動化流程，首先在語言模型的協助下清理分類法，然後通過層次聚合簡化類型約束，最後根據需要過濾事實。最終產生的知識圖譜不受任何類型違規的影響，通過網頁介面公開提供，便於輕鬆探索和後續應用。
